title: Mom Is Five Minutes Away
trend: TikTok 'Go, Go, Go' (lip-sync to a frantic 'go' audio with on-screen text about urgent situations; New Engen TikTok list, updated Nov 13 2026, US) + Saturday morning apartment cleanup — roommates Jamal and Wren get a text that Jamal's mom is five minutes away and speed-clean in a 'go, go, go' panic while the ancient pizza box on the counter refuses to leave; twist: the text was meant for Jamal's brother upstairs, Mom only stopped by to say hi, sees the spotless place and moves Thanksgiving for twenty two people here

Jamal's mom is five minutes away and the apartment is a disaster. Wren has a plan, the pizza box on the counter has rights, and Mom has news nobody is ready for.

lines.text: Wren. My mom just texted. She is five minutes away.
Go. Go. Go.
Where do we even start?
We start with the thing that smells.
Good morning. You may not move me.
I have lived on this counter since October. I have rights.
There is still one slice in there.
Her name is Pam. She is part of the family now.
Pam goes in the trash. Go. Go. Go.
Over my cardboard.
Four minutes. The dishes!
Put them in the oven.
The oven is already full of dishes.
From last time?
From the time before last time.
Nobody has cooked in this kitchen since the summer. The oven is a cabinet now.
Then the dishes go in the bathtub. Go. Go. Go.
The laundry is in the bathtub.
Then the laundry goes in the dryer.
The dryer is where we keep the snacks.
This apartment is a puzzle with no picture on the box.
Three minutes. Make it smell like a home.
I lit the candle. It says warm cookie.
Now it smells like a cookie that lives with a pizza box.
Thank you. I add depth.
The plant! The plant looks tired.
Turn it toward the window. Plants love a view.
Now it looks tired near a window.
That is a lifestyle. Go. Go. Go.
Two minutes. Hide the box in the closet.
The closet? I have been in the closet. The closet has secrets.
What secrets?
A bike. A lamp shaped like a duck. And four more pizza boxes.
My cousins. We do not talk about them.
One minute. Fridge check. What do we have?
One lemon. Hot sauce. And a battery.
Arrange them. Make it look like a choice.
That is a fruit bowl now. A very sad fruit bowl.
The battery is doing its best.
She's here! Everybody act like we vacuum.
Hi, baby! Oh. Oh my.
Is this the right apartment? It's so clean.
This is how we live, Mom. Every single day.
We love a fruit bowl.
Sweetheart, that text was for your brother. Upstairs. Apartment four B.
Wait. You weren't coming here?
I just stopped by to say hi. But now I've seen this place.
Thanksgiving is here this year. Twenty two people.
Twenty two?
Your aunts, your cousins, Grandpa, and Grandpa's new friend from bowling.
We do not have a table.
You have an oven. I'll bring the turkey Wednesday.
Ma'am, the oven is a cabinet.
Who said that?
Nobody. The candle. It's a very warm cookie.
Love you both. Now let me go surprise your brother.
Wait. He has five minutes too?
He has about one. I'm already on the stairs.
Twenty two people. Twelve days. One lemon.
Do not worry. I will stay for Thanksgiving.
Pam would want that.
Go. Go. Go.
